data.name: ImportWarning_ComputedColumnExpressionLost

data.name: ImportWarning_ComputedColumnExpressionLostWithExpression

data.name: ImportWarning_DisabledConstraintExcluded

data.name: ImportWarning_DomainTypeFlattened

data.name: ImportWarning_ForeignKeyOutsideScope

data.value: {0}.{1}: primary key column corrected to NOT NULL. SQLite's rowid tables allow NULL there unless the primary key is a single INTEGER column (a rowid alias); if existing rows have NULL in it, syncing (table rebuild) from this diagram may fail to migrate the data.
